user.title: Broadlink S1C Alarm Hub
user.description: Enter the IP address of the hub. The MAC address is optional: if you leave it empty it is read from the hub.

data_description.host: Use a fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) so that the address does not change.
data_description.mac: For example 34:EA:34:C8:46:D2. Only needed if automatic detection fails.

error.cannot_connect: The hub did not answer. Check the IP address and that the hub is powered and on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: The hub refused the authentication. If it is locked in the Broadlink app, unlock it first.
error.invalid_mac: This is not a valid MAC address.
error.not_supported: This device is not an S1C alarm hub.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the hub is asked for the state of its sensors. Short key fob presses can be missed when this is long.
